status: Post-diagnostic exploratory Korean compound hypothesis, frozen before any challenger retrieval scores. Separate from the independent primary17 study; do not merge it into the original nine-method macro.
hypothesis: KoDic Compound metadata can expose useful constituent words omitted by the frozen flat stem analysis, while an unchanged exact lane preserves whole-word precision evidence.

data.queries: All identical frozen Korean selected development/test queries and 0/1 judgments. No resampling, exclusions or tuning on these scores. Known Korean language is an oracle hint.

compoundRule: STEM only: expand KoDic Compound entries only when component surfaces concatenate exactly to the original token surface and safe original offsets exist. Emit one flat component sequence; no recursive expansion or arbitrary substring splitting. EXACT remains the frozen precise whole-word analysis. Distinct version/fingerprint and binary/source hashes required.

ranking.engine: Same SQLite FTS5 encoded-token proxy and content/title BM25 weights1/2 as primary
ranking.order: Score descending then identical deterministic document hash rowid
ranking.or: Unique analyzed stem tokens are OR clauses; explicitly quoted full input remains a phrase
ranking.and: Require every unique analyzed stem token; quoted full input remains a phrase
ranking.msm60: Require ceil(0.6 * unique analyzed stem terms), counted inside the matching cursor before top-k; quoted phrases unchanged
ranking.rrf: Fuse exact OR and stem OR ranks, k60, input depth1000/lane, output100; never add raw BM25 scores
ranking.exactTier: Bounded union of exact phrase, exact AND, stem OR candidates; phrase then all-original-terms then remaining stems, with stem rank/document hash ties

checks: Assert all document/query exact-lane token sequences match between variants before ranking; require distinct stem semantic fingerprints. Fresh synthetic retrieval controls cover issue902 vocabulary, whole 승차권 versus unrelated 승차 and 권 contexts, quoted/nonadjacent phrase negatives, and intact exact-lane whole words. Controls are not additional held-out human judgments.

analysis.comparisons: Each challenger method versus its corresponding original-native method, query paired; no cherry-picked language/query cohorts
analysis.uncertainty: 1000 paired query bootstrap replicates, fixed base-policy seed plus compound/size/method; 95% unadjusted intervals conditional on this sampled Korean corpus
analysis.calibration: Shared development-only per-method/per-size balanced-accuracy threshold; report separate no-known-positive acceptance, explicit-negative/unjudged top1 and score distributions
analysis.interpretation: Korean-only post-diagnostic exploratory evidence, not independent confirmation of a globally selected default. Preserve whole-word exact evidence; report gains and regressions together.

privacy: Only public query IDs, metrics, hashes, counts and timing metadata in reports. Public corpus/query strings and analysis caches stay outside Git. No changes to original primary drivers, engine defaults or live stores.
